refine_summary: Encountered two main issues: (1) MCState no longer accepts n_chains parameter, so removed n_chains and chain handling code. (2) TDVP integrator configuration was incorrect - attempted to use nk.dynamics.RK23 but netket has no dynamics module. The correct approach would be to use nk.driver.TDVP with proper integrator specification, but this requires more extensive changes. After 2 iterations (max allowed), the code still fails due to the integrator issue. The n_samples warning persists but is non-fatal.
